experiment: RandomForest baseline trained twice on identical rows with identical hyperparameters, varying only the split rule: row-level stratified (the deployed protocol) vs incident-level GroupShuffleSplit
diagnostic_only: This script does NOT write baseline_model.joblib. The deployed model and every pipeline result derived from it are unchanged.

finding: Holding data, features and hyperparameters fixed and changing only the split rule, holdout accuracy moves from 0.7718 (row-level, 53.3% of holdout rows share an incident with training) to 0.7435 (incident-level, 0.0%). Difference +0.0283, 95% CI [+0.0199, +0.0368] -- excludes 0, so the published baseline is inflated by the split rule by a measurable amount.
